summary: Phase 4 backend-only testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase4.py (21 tests) covering: public /api/plans (prices $19.99/$49.99/$99.99/$199.99 verified), admin plans list+update (enterprise included), admin cost config GET+PUT, platform analytics overview + margin-by-plan, tenant domain-providers catalog/search/purchase (demo_registrar + Domain record created), admin domain-providers GET+PUT, workspaces list with is_current, sessions endpoint scrubs full session_token (only tail exposed), usage/me reads DB-defined trial limits with ai_minutes/calls/sms/ai_interactions metrics, RBAC 403 for tenant owner on all admin.* routes, and non-regression (health, 10 industries, countries/summary, tenants/me, conversations/start). 21/21 PASSED against the public preview URL on first clean run (after a trivial fix to the admin-login response shape expectation — /api/auth/login returns the user at the root, not nested under 'user').

minor.issue: Public endpoint filters by is_public=True, but the 'enterprise' plan is seeded with is_public=True by default (Plan model default) so it is leaked into the public pricing endpoint. Spec says enterprise is 'non-public'. Seed enterprise with is_public=False, or set it explicitly in DEFAULT_PLANS.

Uses PlanIn (same as create) — allows changing the 'key' field in the body; the path key wins because the $set uses the payload as-is but the match is by path. Low risk, but validate payload.key == path key, or drop key from the PUT body model.
Creates a Domain row with no uniqueness check — purchasing the same domain twice creates duplicate rows. Add a (tenant_id, domain) unique index or upsert.
When no cost config exists yet, returns {'costs': {}, 'updated_at': None} without an 'id' field — inconsistent shape vs. after PUT. Minor.
Scrubbing of session_token is done field-by-field after mongo returns; safer to project it out at the find() call ({'session_token': 0}) so it never leaves the DB layer.

Takes tenant_id as a query string param instead of a JSON body — asymmetric with other POSTs and awkward for frontend callers. Also does not emit a new user_sessions row (so /auth/sessions won't show the switch).

action_items: Set is_public=False on the seeded 'enterprise' plan so /api/plans does not expose it.
Validate PUT /api/admin/plans/{key} payload key matches path key.
Add unique index / upsert for (tenant_id, domain) in db.domains, or dedupe on purchase.
Project out session_token in /api/auth/sessions at the DB query level.
Consider making /api/auth/switch accept a JSON body and record a new user_sessions row.
critical_code_review_comments: plans.py: seed_plans is idempotent per-key but will NOT update existing seeded plans if DEFAULT_PLANS is changed later (by design). Document this.

platform_analytics.py: ai_attributed_revenue iterates ALL paid invoices into memory and matches on exact customer_phone — fine at low volume, but will not scale; also mismatches E.164 vs raw digits (normalize both sides).

domain_providers.py: DemoProvider marks .com available only when base length > 7, which is fine for the test query 'hearthhvac' (10 chars) — but means short brands always see .com unavailable. OK for demo; worth a comment.

usage.py: _get_plan_limits defaults to 'trial' when subscription_status != 'active' — matches spec. However, if plan_id is set but subscription_status is 'canceled', it still returns the canceled plan's limits; consider forcing trial for non-active states.

workspaces.py: /auth/workspaces is_current compares user row IDs (per-tenant user rows); correct, but switch_workspace mints a new access token WITHOUT revoking the previous one — token audit becomes partial.
RBAC consistently returns 403 (not 401) for authenticated non-admin users on admin routes — verified across plans, analytics, and domain-providers routers.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers 1 TEST_ owner + onboarded hvac tenant, purchases 1 demo domain (hearthhvac<rand>.com) which creates 1 TEST domain row, tweaks the 'starter' plan sms limit to 999 and the cost_config ai_minutes to 7, and sets admin domain-providers default to manual then back to demo_registrar. The plan + cost mutations are not reverted — admin seeded values are stable across restarts since seed_plans is idempotent per-key. Reset manually if clean baselines are needed for Phase 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py), Phase 2 (test_phase2.py), and Phase 4 (test_phase4.py) suites together cover ~70 tests. Admin login response returns the user object at the ROOT (not nested under 'user'). /api/auth/switch takes tenant_id as a query param. /api/plans currently leaks the enterprise plan (is_public default = True); fix if a 'non-public enterprise' assertion is added later.
rca of the issue: N/A — single assertion fix on login response shape; all other tests passed on first run.
